user_query: I'm a fashion enthusiast and I'm looking for some inspiration. Can you find me a collection of NFTs related to fashion and style? It would be great if you could also provide me with some images of these NFTs. And please check the spelling of famous fashion designers' names.

TaskList.description: Search for a collection of NFTs related to fashion and style.
Retrieve images of the found NFTs.
Check the spelling of famous fashion designers' names.
